latestVersion.changelog:
First release: Sends local image files as native image messages in Feishu via Bot API, not as attachments.

- Added script (feishu_send_image.sh) to send PNG/JPG/GIF/WEBP images directly to Feishu users or groups
- Usage requires specifying image path, receiver ID/type, app ID, and app secret
- Uses Feishu Bot API: authenticates, uploads image, sends message
- Credentials must be manually extracted from ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json
- Replaces previous tool which could only send attachments, enabling true image messages
